description:
Grade a dynasty or redraft trade of any size using current market values. Returns a WIN / EVEN / LOSE verdict, the value total for each side, and structural context the raw chart misses (consolidation, best player in the deal, pick-heavy sides).

USE WHEN: the user asks whether a trade is fair, who wins a deal, or what they should add to even it out.
Pass player names as the user said them — the tool resolves them and tells you if a name was ambiguous or unknown.

format.description: Value set to use. Default 'dynasty'. IMPORTANT: there is exactly ONE dynasty table and its QB values are superflex/market-weighted — dynasty values are not split by 1QB vs superflex or by scoring. The redraft sets ARE split: redraft-{sf,1qb}-{ppr,half,std}.

league_size.description: League team count, 8–16 (default 12). Used only for the transparent roster-spot adjustment.

side_a.description: Players/picks one manager gives up, by name — e.g. ['Bijan Robinson', '2026 2nd'].

side_b.description: Players/picks the other manager gives up, by name.

name: tradegauge_evaluate_trade
title: Grade a trade
